## I’m disappointed with my Airbot Swift…

I’m disappointed with my Airbot Swift purchase at JEM jurong east. Your showroom displayed two rollers, but I received one roller and one brush combination. This difference was never clearly explained before my purchase.  
Your customer service also takes a day to respond, and the replies have not been helpful. Citing customer feedback does not justify failing to inform customers about changes to the product configuration.  
I expect transparency and proper customer service. I would appreciate a clear explanation and a resolution, preferably receiving the two-roller configuration that was displayed in your showroom.
